crossRefs.note: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…

parallels.note: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

translations.web: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
translations.bsb: Once again Abraham spoke to the LORD, “Suppose forty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the forty, I will not do it.”
translations.kjv: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's
translations.asv: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for the forty's sake.
